messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning to run the tenant_id schema add tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Small DDL + async backfill. Need a short quiet window (10–15m), pin API version, and a DB owner for lock handoff. Posting runbook and inputs here.

maria: Ack. Can we shrink to 10m by reducing batch_size?

alex: Yes — target batch_size=500. That shaves ~40% off backfill runtime. Config to apply before run: 
```
jobs.backfill.batch_size=500
jobs.backfill.sleep_ms=50
max_workers=8
```

jamie: Do we route traffic to replicas during the quiesce? Need routing policy change.

ops: We'll route 60% to replicas, 40% fallback to primaries during the window. Pin infra/service: api:v2.3.1 from 01:55–02:20 UTC. I'll update the rollout note.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by @alex for schema-migration/tenant_id_add @ 1746523456

nishant: What's the rollback / escape hatch if the backfill causes long locks or replication lag?

alex: Escape hatch steps: abort backfill -> revert routing -> resume normal ops. Commands: 
```
/ops backfill abort migration tenant_id_add
/ops routing set default
```
If abort doesn't clear locks, fallback is to run pt-online-schema-change (runbook link in infra docs).

maria: I'll watch replication lag and lock metrics. Alert triggers: any lock >5s or repl lag >120s.

ops: Noted. Setting canary group to 5% for first 5m. Will post release-note snippet.

jamie: @deploy-bot please start canary at 01:59 UTC.

deploy-bot: canary started (group=5%, start=1746525540). Initial metrics: canary cpu 48%, avg p95 latency +6ms.

maria: Backfill started at 02:02 UTC. First 10k rows processed, no lock spikes.

nishant: Spotted a 6s advisory lock at 02:04 — backfill paused automatically.

maria: Paused, increasing sleep_ms to 100 and lowering batch_size to 250, resuming.

maria: Resumed with batch_size=250, sleep_ms=100. Monitoring.

ops: Canary looks stable. If no alerts in first 10m we ramp to 50%.

deploy-bot: canary ramp to 50% complete at 1746529150

alex: Backfill completed by 02:25 UTC. Migration applied, no data regressions seen. Reverting pin window to end 02:30 UTC. Release-note snippet: "tenant_id: added nullable tenant_id column + async backfill; no user-visible changes."

jamie: Thanks folks — great coordination. If anything crops up reopen this thread.

deploy-bot: deploy closed by @alex at 1746529900 :white_check_mark:
